name: Cubus Mortis
source:
You live a boring day to day life, full of bothersome work. One day, you find a tiny cube that claims to fulfill your wish, at the cost of someone's life.

That wish could be anything, it's all up to you, and as well as up to you to deal with the consequences.

What choice will you make?

[From [url=https://dream-realms-pictures.itch.io/cubus-mortis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你过着枯燥乏味的日常生活，每天都被繁琐恼人的工作填满。某一天，你捡到了一个微小的立方体，它声称能以某人的性命为代价，实现你的愿望。

那个愿望可以是任何事情，一切全凭你做主——而随之而来的后果，同样得由你自己承担。

你会做出怎样的抉择？

[摘自[url=https://dream-realms-pictures.itch.io/cubus-mortis]itch.io[/url]]
